messages:
Mira (CS): quick weekly check for Veridian Health — saw a notable model mix shift after the v2.3 rollout (canary -> 25%). Fallback rate jumped and latency ticked up. TL;DR below, need ops/eng sync.

Ari (CS): numbers from the dashboard: usage +3% w/w, avg latency +180ms (p50 from 210ms -> 390ms), fallback rate 6.4% (baseline ~0.8%), spend +18%. Not great.

OpsBot: alert: model_fallback_rate > 5% for account=veridian-health across region=us-east-1 (window=15m). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/acc/veridian-health?panel=rollouts

Josh T. (Eng): thanks — can you dump a few request ids that triggered fallbacks? looks like v2.3 quant path may be hitting a kernel fallback on longer contexts. sample ids pls.

Mira (CS): attaching 3 recent req ids from last 30m: req_8a1f, req_8a3b, req_8b22. Customer says they hit truncated outputs and retries. They increased batch size on client recently.

Ari (CS): quick grep of logs (from ops query):
```
SELECT timestamp, req_id, model, route, latency_ms, fallback_reason
FROM inference_logs
WHERE account = 'veridian-health' AND timestamp >= now() - interval '1 hour'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
results show fallback_reason = 'kv_cache_miss -> slow-path' for many entries.

Samir P. (Platform): suggestion — pause canary and reduce rollout to 5% while we triage. Command to patch rollout: `redwood rollout set veridian-health v2.3 --percent 5 --env prod` (will open a short maintenance window if needed). I can run if CS approves.

Mira (CS): please run it, Samir. Also scheduling a 30m sync with Veridian for 30min after rollback to walk through detection and ask them to revert client batch change for now. Proposed times: in 45m or tomorrow 10am PT.

Josh T. (Eng): I'll spin up a short trace capture and instrument kv cache metrics. If fallback is due to cache eviction behavior under batched requests we can tweak the runtime batching policy or recommend reduced client-side batching.

Ari (CS): action items captured: 1) Samir run rollout patch -> 5% (in progress) 2) Josh capture traces & identify kernel fallback cause 3) Mira schedule customer sync and ask to revert client batch change 4) Ari will monitor spend & fallback trend and update this thread.

OpsBot: rollout patch job started by Samir P. job_id=rb-2051236950 status=running

Mira (CS): thanks team. Please post brief updates here. I'll flag renewal risk if fallback > 5% for >24h. :warning:

Samir P. (Platform): rollout reduced to 5% — job_id=rb-2051236950 status=complete. Noted.

Josh T. (Eng): initial trace shows increased KV cache churn when client batch_size > 16 with long contexts (>=1024). Hypothesis: prefix caching TTL + batching causing more cache misses. Will validate and propose runtime config change.

Ari (CS): monitoring — fallback rate down to 2.1% within 20m of rollback, latency p50 back to ~230ms. I'll keep watching over the next 6 hours and update the Veridian health report.

Mira (CS): great, let's reconvene tomorrow EOD if things aren't fully stabilized. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
